name: komdosh-dev-infra-iac
description: Terraform and OpenTofu authoring, plan-safety analysis, and state discipline, with the Yandex Cloud resource layer built in. One agent writes and one reviews, and they never overlap. The reviewer anchors on the plan rather than the source, because destroys and replaces hide there — an additive-looking diff can produce a forced replacement that destroys a database. Secure-and-HA by default on YC: regional K8s masters, HA managed databases with backups, Lockbox and KMS, least-privilege IAM, and 152-FZ data residency. Never runs apply or destroy. Requires komdosh-dev-infra-core.
